claim_ceiling: One durable mixed-owner longitudinal fixture, not a general lifelong-development proof. It establishes coexistence, restart behavior and selective drift isolation for the tested hierarchy/language/N1A/value surfaces.
observed: A fully trained hierarchy accepted an independently scoped N1A capability while all hierarchy capabilities were rejected from N1A eligibility by obligation/scope mismatch.
Grounded token binding was added to the same Microseed and retained semantic/truth/language/execution authority NONE.
N1A executed EXP-X once, actual outcome was recorded, and the same capability epoch could not regain first-exposure authority.
Hierarchy routing remained current and executable after language grounding and N1A history accumulated.
After restart, learned hierarchy lineage persisted but runtime contracts were absent and routing was stale until explicit runtime re-registration.
Exact runtime descriptor re-registration restored hierarchy routing and grounded token currentness without changing authority ceilings.
N1A consumption remained durable across restart and did not execute again.
Invalidating only SIG-X staled only the grounded token binding; hierarchy routing remained current and N1A history remained consumed.
